crop.notes: Right edge of the column is cut off (ends of lines missing); 657 is a fuller crop of the same item on the same page

ocr.notes: Line ends lost to the crop; 'JOBN IVAN' is John Sullivan, '$1,' is $1,000, '100 miles of New Orleans' garbled

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that Richard K. Fox deposited $1,000 with Harry Hill to back Tom Allen against any pugilist, John L. Sullivan preferred, for the world championship near New Orleans.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Tuesday Morning, October 31, 1882, page 4. Duplicate of 657.

facts.fact: Richard K. Fox deposited $1,000 with Harry Hill and challenged on Allen's behalf any pugilist, John L. Sullivan preferred, for the championship of the world, $1,000 to $2,500 a side, within 100 miles of New Orleans within three months of signing articles

notes: Same item and page as 657; consider keeping only one. Allen is called 'the ex-champion of America'.
